title: Volume models
description: 5 volume models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.
html:
5 volume models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: a CT volume [D, H, W] in Hounsfield units and its voxel spacing in mm (volume.read_nifti reads both from a NIfTI file). Output: a class index per voxel [D, H, W] on the input grid (0 = background). Encoder models (nnFoundation) take a CT or MRI volume and give its encoder feature maps.

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.10.0+cu130, torch 2.14.1+cu130; fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW measures yours. The summary uses one input, 200x200: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under torch.compile and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable (export; memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured; no kernels = the family has no kernels backend (reason under its table).

Other devices: Apple M1 Pro 16 GB, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA L40S, NVIDIA A10, NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000; across devices.
